footnote_text: Represents restricted stock units of the Issuer's Class A Common Stock payable as a result of the payment of a cash dividend on the Issuer's Class A Common Stock. The restricted stock units are payable solely in shares of the Issuer's Class A Common Stock issued to the Reporting Person in respect of restricted stock units previously granted under the Issuer's 2019 Long-Term Stock Incentive Plan.
